'''Dark Side:''' Blank.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Kashyyyk: Chewie's Hut]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Kashyyyk: Chewie's Hut]] (published 2 December 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Kashyyyk: Chewie’s Hut”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
